In this section we have a mountain of rubber, and a ball which weighs 1,600 pounds. There is a fine picture of a native tapping a rubber tree and numerous very beautiful photographs.

arxiv-2011-05876.title: Testing the equivalence principle on cosmological scales using the odd multipoles of galaxy cross-power spectrum and bispectrum
arxiv-2011-05876.creator: Robert Crittenden
arxiv-2011-05876.description: Abstract One of the cornerstones of general relativity is the equivalence principle. However, the validity of the equivalence principle has only been established on solar system scales for standard matter fields; this result cannot be assumed to hold for the non-standard matter fields that dominate the gravitational dynamics on cosmological scales.

arxiv-2012-07020.title: Inter-orbital nematicity and the origin of a single electron Fermi pocket in FeSe
arxiv-2012-07020.creator: Daniel Steffensen 1 , Andreas Kreisel 2 , P. J. Hirschfeld 1,3 , Brian M. Andersen 1
arxiv-2012-07020.description: Abstract The electronic structure of the enigmatic iron-based superconductor FeSe has puzzled researchers since spectroscopic probes failed to observe the expected electron pocket at the Y Y point in the 1-Fe Brillouin zone. It has been speculated that this pocket, essential for an understanding of the superconducting state, is either absent or incoherent.

arxiv-2104-01840.title: Large ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu} and signals of decays e b → e a ​ γ e_{b}\rightarrow e_{a}\gamma in a 3-3-1 model with inverse seesaw neutrinos
arxiv-2104-01840.creator: L. T. Hue, H. T. Hung, N. T. Tham, H. N. Long, T.Phong Nguyen
arxiv-2104-01840.description: Abstract We show that under current experimental bounds of the decays e a → e b ​ γ e_{a}\rightarrow e_{b}\gamma , the recent experimental data of the muon anomalous magnetic dipole moment ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu} can be explained in the framework of the 3-3-1 model with right-handed neutrinos.

arxiv-2107-01173.title: Momentum Accelerates the Convergence of Stochastic AUPRC Maximization
arxiv-2107-01173.creator: Guanghui Wang wanggh@lamda.nju.edu.cn
arxiv-2107-01173.description: Abstract In this paper, we study stochastic optimization of areas under precision-recall curves (AUPRC), which is widely used for combating imbalanced classification tasks. Although a few methods have been proposed for maximizing AUPRC, stochastic optimization of AUPRC with convergence guarantee remains an undeveloped territory.

arxiv-2107-09582.title: Photonic chip-based continuous-travelling-wave parametric amplifier
arxiv-2107-09582.creator: Johann Riemensberger, Junqiu Liu, Nikolai Kuznetsov, Jijun He, Rui Ning Wang, Tobias J. Kippenberg
arxiv-2107-09582.description: Abstract The ability to amplify optical signals is of pivotal importance across science and technology. The development of erbium-doped-fiber-based optical amplifiers Mears et al. 1987 ; Desurvire et al. 1987 has revolutionized optical communications, which are today ubiquitously used in virtually all sensing and communication applications of coherent laser sources.

arxiv-2201-10651.title: Nucleon-Nucleon Short-Ranged Correlations, β \beta Decay and the Unitarity of the CKM Matrix
arxiv-2201-10651.creator: Levi Condren and Gerald A. Miller
arxiv-2201-10651.description: Abstract The influence of nucleon-nucleon short-ranged correlations (SRC) on nuclear super-allowed β \beta decay is examined. The need for this is driven by the observed depletion of spectroscopic strength obtained in studies of ( e , e ′ ) (e,e^{\prime}) and ( d , 3 He ) (d,^{3}{\rm He}) reactions on a wide variety of nuclei.

arxiv-2201-13063.description: Abstract . The fields of SocialVR, performance capture, and virtual try-on are often faced with a need to faithfully reproduce real garments in the virtual world. One critical task is the disentanglement of the intrinsic garment shape from deformations due to fabric properties, physical forces, and contact with the body.

arxiv-2303-06945.title: CoGANPPIS: A Coevolution-enhanced Global Attention Neural Network for Protein-Protein Interaction Site Prediction
arxiv-2303-06945.creator: Jiaxing Guo, Xuening Zhu, Zixin Hu, Xiaoxi Hu

Accurate prediction of protein-protein interaction sites (PPIs) is crucial for our understanding of biological mechanism. arxiv-2310-20660.title: Pseudo-Kähler and hypersymplectic structures on semidirect products
arxiv-2310-20660.creator: Diego Conti and Alejandro Gil-García
arxiv-2310-20660.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Diego Conti and Alejandro Gil-García. We study left-invariant pseudo-Kähler and hypersymplectic structures on semidirect products G ⋊ H G\rtimes H ; we work at the level of the Lie algebra 𝔤 ⋊ 𝔥 \mathfrak{g}\rtimes\mathfrak{h} . In particular we consider the structures induced on 𝔤 ⋊ 𝔥 \mathfrak{g}\rtimes\mathfrak{h} by existing pseudo-Kähler structures on 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} and 𝔥 \mathfrak{h} ; we classify all semidirect products of this type with 𝔤 \mathfrak{g} of dimension 4 4 and 𝔥 = ℝ 2 \mathfrak{h}=\mathbb{R}^{2} .

arxiv-2411-19482.description: Abstract As we all know, the k k -ary n n -cube is a highly efficient interconnect network topology structure. It is also a concept of great significance, with a broad range of applications spanning both mathematics and computer science.

arxiv-2412-14451.title: CLDG: Contrastive Learning on Dynamic Graphs
arxiv-2412-14451.creator: Yiming Xu, Bin Shi, Teng Ma, Bo Dong, Haoyi Zhou, Qinghua Zheng
arxiv-2412-14451.description: Abstract The graph with complex annotations is the most potent data type, whose constantly evolving motivates further exploration of the unsupervised dynamic graph representation. One of the representative paradigms is graph contrastive learning. It constructs self-supervised signals by maximizing the mutual information between the statistic graph’s augmentation views.

arxiv-2512-06255.title: Language-driven Fine-grained Retrieval
arxiv-2512-06255.creator: Shijie Wang, Xin Yu, Yadan Luo, Zijian Wang, Pengfei Zhang, Zi Huang
arxiv-2512-06255.description: Abstract Existing fine-grained image retrieval (FGIR) methods learn discriminative embeddings by adopting semantically sparse one-hot labels derived from category names as supervision. While effective on seen classes, such supervision overlooks the rich semantics encoded in category names, hindering the modeling of comparability among cross-category details and, in turn, limiting generalization to unseen categories.

arxiv-2512-14469.title: Distribution questions for Isogeny Graphs over Finite Fields
arxiv-2512-14469.creator: Anwesh Ray
arxiv-2512-14469.description: Abstract . In the first part of the paper, we fix a non-CM elliptic curve E / ℚ E/\mathbb{Q} and an odd prime ℓ \ell and investigate the distribution of invariants associated to the ℓ \ell –volcano containing the reduction E p E_{p} , as p p ranges over primes of good ordinary reduction.

arxiv-2601-05118.title: Scalable Generation of Macroscopic Fock States Exceeding 10,000 Photons
arxiv-2601-05118.creator: Ming Li, Weizhou Cai, Ziyue Hua, Yifang Xu, Yilong Zhou, Zi-Jie Chen, Xu-Bo Zou, Guang-Can Guo, Luyan Sun, Chang-Ling Zou
arxiv-2601-05118.description: Abstract The scalable preparation of bosonic quantum states with macroscopic excitations poses a fundamental challenge in quantum technologies, limited by control complexity and photon-loss rates that severely constrain prior theoretical and experimental efforts to merely dozens of excitations per mode.

arxiv-2602-06790.title: Heralding efficiency and brightness optimization of a micro-ring resonator via tunable coupling
arxiv-2602-06790.creator: Nathan Moses, Marcus J. Clark, Alex S. Clark, Siddarth K. Joshi, Imad I. Faruque
arxiv-2602-06790.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Nathan Moses, Marcus J. Clark, Alex S. Clark, Siddarth K. Joshi, Imad I. Faruque. Efficient and bright single photon sources on photonic chips are key to scaling quantum technologies. Spontaneous four wave mixing in micro-ring resonators creates excellent narrowband and tunable photon sources. We experimentally demonstrate the optimization of heralding efficiency and brightness by tuning the coupling of the pump, signal and idler modes into the resonator whilst operating in a pulsed pump regime.

arxiv-2602-14418.title: Establishing the Primary HEFT as a Precision Benchmark for UV-HEFT Matching
arxiv-2602-14418.creator: Zizhou Ge, Huayang Song, Xia Wan
arxiv-2602-14418.description: Abstract We match the real Higgs triplet model (RHTM) onto HEFT under different parameter choices and power-counting schemes, thereby obtaining several representative HEFT formulations and clarifying their relations. We establish the primary HEFT (pHEFT) as a benchmark framework, demonstrating that alternative HEFT constructions can be systematically derived from it.

pmc-10532453.title: Phrenic Nerve Transfer to Musculocutaneous Nerve: An Anatomical and Histological Study
pmc-10532453.creator: Alexandra Fochtmann-Frana, Bettina Pretterklieber, Christine Radtke, Michael L. Pretterklieber
pmc-10532453.description: Background: To restore elbow flexor muscle function in case of traumatic brachial plexus avulsion, the phrenic nerve transfer to the musculocutaneous nerve has become part of clinical practice. The nerve transfer can be done by means of video-assisted thoracic surgery without nerve graft or via supraclavicular approach in combination with an autograft.

pmc-10624442.title: Employers’ Perception and Practice of Workplace Violence Prevention at Healthcare Facilities Questionnaire: A Confirmatory Factor Analysis
pmc-10624442.creator: Mohd Nizam Mohamad Yazid, Nik Rosmawati Nik Husain, Aziah Daud, Yelmizaitun Osman, Normazura Mustapa, Azlihanis Abdul Hadi
pmc-10624442.description: BackgroundWorkplace violence prevention initiatives are undeniably lacking in healthcare facilities. The aim of this study was to validate a newly developed questionnaire and assess employers’ perceptions and practices towards workplace violence prevention at healthcare facilities.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted from October 2021 to November 2021 by recruiting 333 employers at healthcare facilities in Kelantan, Malaysia.

pmc-10638490.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). pmc-11438956.title: Investigating the association between the triglyceride-glucose index and peripheral artery disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11438956.creator: Amirsaeed Samavarchitehrani, Alessandro Cannavo, Amir Hossein Behnoush, Ali Kazemi Abadi, Zahra Shokri Varniab, Amirmohammad Khalaji
pmc-11438956.description: BackgroundPeripheral artery disease (PAD) is a common disease associated with atherosclerosis, leading to significant mortality and morbidity worldwide. Our study focuses on the association between insulin resistance (IR) and PAD, specifically investigating the triglyceride-glucose index (TyG) as a potential surrogate marker of IR in the context of PAD by pooling the existing studies on this topic.

pmc-11476855.title: Germline DNA Damage Repair Gene Alterations in Patients with Metachronous Breast and Colorectal Cancer
pmc-11476855.creator: Rolando André Rios Villacis, Luiza Côrtes, Tatiane Ramos Basso, Luisa Matos do Canto, Jeferson Santos Souza, Mads Malik Aagaard, Maria Nirvana da Cruz Formiga, Samuel Aguiar, Maria Isabel Achatz, Silvia Regina Rogatto, Maria Gazouli
pmc-11476855.description: A hereditary component of breast (BC) and colorectal cancer (CRC) has been described in approximately one-third of these tumor types. BC patients have an increased risk of developing CRC as a second primary tumor and vice versa. Germline genomic variants (NextSeq550, Illumina) were investigated in 24 unrelated BC and/or CRC patients and 7 relatives from 3 index patients.

pmc-12958415.title: Multiphasic anaphylaxis in the emergency and intensive care setting
pmc-12958415.creator: Margret Ann Schneider, Hans de Groot, Jan-Willem Geerts
pmc-12958415.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). SummaryAnaphylaxis, the most severe form of an allergic reaction, is a potentially life-threatening systemic reaction requiring prompt and effective management. A subset of cases shows a recurrence of symptoms despite adequate care and full clinical response. These biphasic or even multiphasic courses provide a unique challenge for clinicians, especially as reported incidence varies, risk factors are unclear and clear management strategies are lacking in current guidelines.

pmc-13372676.title: Rising dust pollution across Europe in a changing climate
pmc-13372676.creator: Petros N. Vasilakos, Abhishek Upadhyay, Manousos I. Manousakas, Andrés Alastuey, James D. Allan, Célia A. Alves, Benjamin Bergmans, Benjamin T. Brem, Sonia Castillo, Theodoros Christoudias, Cristina Colombi, Sébastien Conil, Katja Dzepina, Anja Eichler, Konstantinos Eleftheriadis, Olivier Favez, Mic
pmc-13372676.description: Mineral desert dust is a major contributor to total atmospheric particulate matter1. Desert dust outbreaks degrade air quality and can pose adverse health effects2, including asthma exacerbation3 and increased mortality4. At some European locations, there has been a rise in the intensity and frequency of transported dust outbreaks from deserts in recent decades5–9.

pmc-13573178.title: Laparoscopically guided biopsy of non-macroscopically altered cecocolic lymph nodes in dog cadavers using laparoscopic forceps or core needles
pmc-13573178.creator: Jane Karlla de Oliveira Matos, Vitor Ângelo Musial, Pauline Silva dos Santos, Bernardo Nascimento Antunes, Leonardo Gruchowskei, Fabiana Elias, Camila Dalmolin, Maurício Veloso Brun, Fabíola Dalmolin
pmc-13573178.description: Minimally invasive techniques allow tissue sampling while limiting procedural invasiveness. This study compared the quality of biopsy samples obtained through laparoscopically guided core needle (16 G or 18 G), laparoscopic pancreatic forceps or laparoscopic cup forceps with teeth for sampling non-grossly enlarged cecocolic lymph nodes in dog cadavers.

pmc-13634695.title: Mechanical Thrombectomy for Acute Vertebrobasilar Occlusion Associated with Mycoplasma pneumoniae Pneumonia in a Child: A Case Report
pmc-13634695.creator: Yoshitaka Yamaguchi, Daisuke Shimbo, Mayuko Ota, Shigetoshi Ogiwara, Soichiro Wada, Shunsuke Takechi, Michiko Abe, Akira Yoshida, Tatsuro Takada
pmc-13634695.description: ObjectiveDue to its rarity, high-quality evidence regarding mechanical thrombectomy for pediatric acute ischemic stroke remains limited. Mycoplasma pneumoniae is a common cause of community-acquired pneumonia in children, and a recognized but uncommon cause of pediatric ischemic stroke. Reports describing large-vessel occlusion associated with M. pneumoniae infection are rare, and the role of mechanical thrombectomy in this setting remains unclear.
